summary: DarkIris Inc., a Hong Kong-based technology firm, filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited interim financial statements and a press release covering the six months ended March 31, 2026. Revenue rose 13.9% to $5.93 million, gross profit improved 20.9%, and net loss widened to $1.90 million. Management cited strategic expenditures, game enhancements, professional fees from its Nasdaq listing, and an AIGC video platform launch. No special-situation transaction or event is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings report for a foreign private issuer.
